name: ElegantFin TV
description: Minimal ElegantFin design with native Jellyfin motion and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Add a personal TV theme switch to display settings, stored per account on the server. Keep re-enabling available while the theme is off. Remove appearance, diagnostics and comparison settings; legacy debug values are ignored.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
